reasons: The cited § 7.6 is a Vendor-granted MFN running in Customer's favour (Fees to Customer no less favourable than those offered to similarly situated customers), which is exactly the rule's preferred position of no MFN obligation on Customer.

Consistent with the compliant status, the redline is identical to the original paragraph and no counterparty comment is proposed — appropriate, since the rule expressly says not to redline Vendor-granted MFNs.
Rationale accurately documents the search for MFN/best-terms/price-matching obligations burdening Customer and found none; no deterministic check failures contradict this.
